name: maera-monorepo
description: maera — UI-ready JavaScript framework untuk dashboard IoT deklaratif (1 file index.maera = 1 dashboard).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @maera/core && npm run build -w @maera/ui && npm run build -w @maera/cli
scripts.example: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/bin.js build examples/index.maera -o dist/example.html
